title: Subscription Policy

body.value: Our current plans, prices and what each includes are always shown on our Subscribe page. Plans and prices may change; if a change affects your plan, we will tell you before your next renewal (see “Price and plan changes” below).

In general terms:

  • Free plan: registered access to the site with limited premium content.
  • Paid plans: depending on the plan, full access to premium news and exclusive content, fewer or no advertisements, premium video, and access to some or all eligible courses.

Paid plans are billed for the period shown with the price (for example, monthly). If we offer other periods, such as quarterly or yearly, the price and period are shown before you pay. Your billing period starts on the day your payment succeeds.

When you subscribe with a card, UPI AutoPay or another method that supports it, you authorise a recurring payment (an “e-mandate”). Your plan then renews automatically at the end of each billing period, at the price then in force, until you cancel.

• Before each renewal charge, you receive a pre-debit notification at least 24 hours in advance, as RBI rules require, showing the amount, the date and our name.
  • You can cancel the auto-renewal at any time, from your account page (when available), by emailing desk@example.com, or through your bank or UPI app.
  • Payments above the limit set by RBI for automatic recurring payments may need you to approve them with an OTP or PIN.

You can cancel at any time. Cancelling stops all future renewals. Your access continues until the end of the billing period you have already paid for, and then your account moves to the free plan. We confirm every cancellation by email. Refunds are covered by our Refund Policy.
If you pay for a single period without setting up auto-renewal, your plan simply ends at the end of that period. We will remind you before it ends so you can renew if you wish.

• Upgrade: takes effect immediately. You pay the difference in price for the rest of your current billing period (pro-rated), and the new price applies from your next renewal.
  • Downgrade: takes effect at your next renewal. You keep your current plan until then.

If a renewal payment fails, we will let you know and try again. You keep access for a grace period of 7 days. If the payment still hasn't gone through by then, your account moves to the free plan, and you can subscribe again at any time.

A subscription is for one person. Please don't share your sign-in details or paid content with others. To protect your account we may limit how many devices can use it at the same time, and we may ask you to sign in again or suspend an account that shows clear signs of sharing or misuse.
Prices shown on the site are in Indian rupees and include GST unless stated otherwise. We issue a GST invoice for every payment, available in your account or by email. Our GSTIN is 32AAAAA0000A1Z5.

We may change prices, features or plans. If a change affects your plan, we will tell you by email at least 7 days before the renewal at which it applies, so you can cancel before then if you wish. If the new price needs a fresh e-mandate approval, we will ask you for it. If we discontinue a plan, we will move you to a similar plan or refund the unused part of your period, as set out in our Refund Policy.
We may suspend or end a subscription that is used in breach of our Terms and Conditions, for example to share paid content publicly or to scrape the site.
Subscription questions: desk@example.com. Complaints: our Grievance Officer at desk@example.com. We acknowledge complaints within 24 hours and resolve them within one month at the latest.
